revisions.title: A rule for hearing the cosmology
revisions.body: The prelude gives us one listening rule: an account should fit the kind of thing it explains. Timaeus says that an account of what is stable should itself be stable and firm. I take that as a limit on our expectations: the form of an account should answer to its subject.
